title: Flights from London
statementMd:
List flights departing from `LHR`: id, destination and date.

Expected columns: `id`, `destination`, `depart_date`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT id, destination, depart_date FROM flights WHERE origin = 'LHR';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
